race.comment: YAUSON (13) was an enormous run last start at Caulfield when heavily supported, racing three-and-four-wide with no cover throughout in midfield, still picking up late to miss by a long neck. The ride left a bit to be desired there, expect Childs to be positive and surge forward. If he does, he'll be very hard to run down. CHISPA (10) hasn't done much in three runs this time in but the effort two back behind Unleeshing was sound and there's been winning form out of that. She got a long way back in the G3 Tesio last week, now J-Mac goes on from an inside gate so expect much more intent. ICHNUSA (14) got too far back first up at Caulfield but the late splits suggest he ran well enough. Fitter now with upside and should improve. JOHNICH (7) beat YAUSON last time and is racing very well, he'll take holding out again. FEDERER (8) needs another win but will be strong late back in trip.
